original_record.name: 45 degree bicycle twisting crunch
original_record.description: A twisting bicycle crunch with the torso leaning back at 45 degrees. It strongly targets the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit and lean back to about 45 degrees with your feet raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in as you twist the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your chest lifted and your core tight.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Resolve the requested ID to one of the existing canonical catalogue IDs; carry complete instructions, evidence, original record/hash, alias resolution and all source gaps into the authoring context.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Prepared packet resolves an existing ID, preserves all source steps/reasons and includes the baseline requirement IDs and relevant known issues.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Keep source facts, reversible authored choices, measured-but-unapproved values and unresolved decisions separate. Do not treat source completeness or a staging proposal as production acceptance.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Each critical choice cites source evidence or an explicit authoring basis; unresolved source blockers remain visible, and conflict dispositions are recorded.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Use repository exercise text with notices and the accepted CC0 continuous body. Do not open, feed to AI, trace, copy or derive animations from Gym Visual media.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Inputs/provenance identify authorized text/body sources and exclude restricted exercise media; required notices are retained.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Preserve the accepted continuous CC0 skin, source geometry and atlas binding. Do not recreate clothing, add disconnected muscle shells or generate new all-body textures that reintroduce seams.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Confirm source signature, one connected body, finite weights and unchanged intended topology; inspect posed skin for seams and intersections.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Create an exercise-specific action; remove inherited source actions and do not reuse the former squat trajectory or a generic bobbing cycle for unrelated exercises.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Clip/action ID, phase order and sampled geometry correspond to this exercise and its recorded authoring choices.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Name actual evaluated-skin contact patches and supporting surfaces per phase. Global minZ, a single bone target or whole-group extrema cannot by themselves establish contact.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: For each active support, inspect signed distance distribution, near-contact area/fraction, penetration and tangential drift in a declared world frame, on native and runtime skins.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Solve simultaneous pelvis/heel/sole/palm supports together with lumbar clearance and joint pose. Do not translate the whole body by an illustrative glute-proxy gap.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Intended contacts share the declared support plane/geometry without back/limb penetration; lifted contacts stay clear in their noncontact phases; review start/mid/top and transitions.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Define exercise-specific joint/segment targets, angle conventions, poles, ranges, phase timing and rotation continuity. Unsupported numerical limits remain null/unapproved.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Measurements state reference frame/basis; no unexplained target, elbow/knee flip, limb twist or self-intersection; source torso angles are not relabeled validated anatomical limits.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Specify palm orientation, grip or open-hand contact and articulated fingers together with shoulder/elbow/wrist pose. For 0001 resolve palm/head placement and natural arm bends.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Review both hands and elbows at start/mid/top; check actual palm/head/support clearances, wrist orientation and intersections, not only rig endpoints.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Where the exercise hops, author grounded compression, forefoot push-off, flight and controlled landing with coherent knee/hip/travel and free-leg behavior.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Sample every support-state transition and inspect actual decoded/runtime motion from complementary views; no planted-foot sliding or rigid whole-body bobbing.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Retain catalogue labels; explicitly record illustrative main/additional/stretch overrides and actual anatomical L/R sides per phase. Keep inactive skin uniformly neutral with no inactive fibers.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Resolve exact region IDs and review group/proxy meaning. Surface/deep/group/proxy/systemic/unsupported statuses remain explicit; do not invent localized patches for unsupported/systemic labels.

baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Coverage records name region/side/phase and a useful view, or an explicit deep/unsupported/occlusion limitation; review actual images/runtime.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Disable cast shadows, cavity/AO and specular overlays in native and runtime rendering; do not bake background, fake cavities or all-body fibers into the selected atlas.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Inspect overlapping limbs and selected/unselected pixels in actual native/runtime output; verify lighting flags and uniform inactive body.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Retain original-source correspondence across glTF UV splits. If bitmap atlases are used, preserve their exported UV channel1; source-index heat attributes do not require color textures.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Texture paths report the correct atlas channel when used; heat-field paths resolve _SOURCE_INDEX and share scalar values across seam copies. Selected fields follow the deformed skin.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Share one rig/skeleton/mixer update across synchronized views. Reuse a surface scalar attribute for the heat candidate, with no color textures. Legacy bitmap paths use2048x1024 atlases with a lazy neutral/active cache, disposal and stale-load protection.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Probe one model/skeleton/mixer and one pose update for all views. The heat candidate uses zero color textures; bitmap paths retain at most neutral/current color states. Distinguish internal bone textures from color textures.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Check actual exported runtime against Blender and acknowledge runtime cage versus native corrective-smooth/subdivision differences. Bone parity alone does not validate skin contact or appearance.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Compare sampled bones plus relevant evaluated surface patches, atlas placement, contact appearance and visibility in both paths.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Check actual GLB pose/contact continuity and live-loop playback, including resume after seeking to the endpoint. Do not encode or decode new videos for this workflow.
baseline_requirements.acceptance_check: Record exact model/runtime hashes, action duration, sampled pose parity and loop/restart interaction in Three.js. Confirm zero video outputs/requests. Historical decode receipts do not replace live runtime checks.

baseline_requirements.requirement: Preserve open issues and actual evidence scope. Existing-source checks are reusable only for unchanged inputs; no catalogue-wide production, anatomy, coaching or EMG certification is implied.

required_qa: At the left-knee peak, the right shoulder/elbow must turn forward toward that knee; reverse the pairing at the right-knee peak. Check anatomical sides in world coordinates, not screen direction.
Compare crossed elbow/knee distance and shoulder-forward direction at both peaks. Export parity with a wrong source pose is insufficient.
Check actual fingertip/scalp clearance and seated pelvic support while both feet remain airborne.
